source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U22: Trace appointment,rotation and special appointment routes

payload.title: Record the route and the end of office
payload.core_explanation_md:
The general appointment route uses company approval, identification, eligibility and consent requirements. Public-company rotation uses the described two-thirds rotational pool and one-third retirement rule, excluding independent directors from the relevant total. Longest service since appointment and the statutory tie process determine who retires; do not apply the fraction to every director indiscriminately.

Additional, alternate and casual-vacancy directors have different authority and term limits. An additional director term ends at the earlier of the next AGM and its due date. An alternate appointment needs the relevant authorisation and qualifying absence from India; return and the original term matter. A casual vacancy does not create a fresh full term. Separate appointment motions are the default, with the specified unanimous procedural qualification. Candidature notice/deposit exceptions and consent filings need the current rules.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a casual-vacancy appointment automatically grant an entirely new full term?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The predecessor remaining term limits it.

payload.stem_md: An additional director stays in office because the next AGM was delayed beyond its due date. Which limit is relevant?

options.text_md: Only the actual delayed meeting date
options.explanation_md: The primary text uses the earlier-event limit.
Preference does not fix the term.

options.text_md: The earlier of the next AGM and the date it should have been held
options.explanation_md: Delay does not automatically extend the appointment.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Delay does not automatically extend the appointment.

payload.stem_md: A casual vacancy is filled and the appointee claims a fresh full term unrelated to the predecessor. What should be checked?

options.explanation_md: That does not settle this term.

options.explanation_md: This route has its own limits.

options.text_md: A rule that vacancies can never be filled
Whether the appointee has more shares
options.explanation_md: Share count does not create a new term.
